Problem

The work starts in chat.
Then you have to copy it into another app.

  • A customer books an appointment→you enter it in your calendar.
  • A customer confirms an order→you enter it in Shopify or the POS.
  • A customer sends a payment receipt→you record it in Excel.
  • Your team agrees on a video meeting→you schedule it in Google Meet.
  • Your team agrees who will handle a lead→you update the CRM.
  • Your team reports stock used→you update the ERP.
AgimonNEXT ↓   04 / 13
Solution

Agimon lets you finish the work
right where it starts.

Business tools and a virtual employee live inside chat.

No copying. No second system to update.
Do the work once.
